state: finite typed cell vector plus designated graph incidence
event: simultaneous constant overwrite with explicit unary guard observations
selection: one Boolean decision per tag; retaining a tag retains all occurrences
receipts: rebased in the selected execution context
typing: base/final checks plus static event preservation rule; not a full dynamic graph typecheck after every step
one_write_result: polynomial closure and unique maximum valid retention under stated fragment
two_write_result: NP-complete with Boolean cells, <=2 writes/cell, exactly one event/aspect, one forced keep and one forced removal
two_write_nonclaim: events may have polynomial footprint; constant-arity hardness is not proved
sas_source: supplied executable full plan reaching its terminal goal; equality preconditions and simultaneous constant effects only
sas_admission: coded case including any terminal label/event must fit implementation bounds; invalid full history or unreached goal rejected
sas_supporters: exists fresh option variables per read; base option only if equality holds; strict j<k<i opponents; not exactly-one or universal
sas_selection: u_i=[a_i in M] binds all occurrences of an original label
sas_goal: nonempty goal adds one write-free fresh label pinned kept; preserves original writer occurrences but not general forced-keep count
prime_boundary: auxiliary-free local primes for one observation; globally exact conjunction need not be globally prime
prior_coverage: joint two-write/one-event/one-keep/one-removal coverage unresolved; no priority claim
